verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents a few built-in automations. Accepting a quote can automatically convert it to an invoice and send it, and payment reminders can be automated. These are fixed event-driven behaviors, not a documented engine where users define their own trigger→action rules. Scheduled and recurring invoices are time-based, not event-triggered, so they do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: a user-definable workflow rules engine (custom triggers, conditions and actions), configuration docs for reminder rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: When your customer accepts a quote, automatically convert it to an invoice and send it out for payment.
